name: Submit monthly invoice
description: Create a monthly invoice in Ledgerly for one client, attach the PDF, review the totals, and stop for approval before it is sent.

variables.name: clientName
variables.description: The client the invoice is raised against, as it appears in Ledgerly

variables.name: invoicePdfName
variables.description: File name of the prepared invoice PDF to attach

steps.fallback: If a sign-in page appears instead, stop and ask the user to sign in; never enter credentials.

target.visualDescription: primary button at the top right of the invoice list

steps.fallback: If there is no New invoice button, look for a plus control in the invoices toolbar.
If the field is a searchable dropdown, type the name and pick the exact match.
If the period is a month picker rather than a text field, select the month named by the variable.

steps.instruction: Attach the prepared invoice PDF {{invoicePdfName}} to the invoice.

target.visualDescription: attachment row below the line items

steps.fallback: If no file chooser opens, tell the user which control was found and stop rather than guessing.

steps.instruction: Open the review screen and read the invoice total back to the user.
steps.fallback: If the review screen does not load, report the current URL and stop.
If sending fails, leave the invoice as a draft and tell the user.

blockedActions: solving or bypassing a CAPTCHA or anti-bot challenge
completing an identity or email verification
entering a password, passcode, one-time code, or 2FA response
changing the client's bank details or payment terms
